column5: READ LIVE 2026-09-22 with get_metadata, node by node, to test the wave-59 row rather than carry it - a note is a LEAD - and its two STILL OPEN items are now measured and BUILT (skai-gaming e663e690). THE GEOMETRY, re-derived here rather than restated: the frame is 375 x 347; the grid `Frame 1000004029` 9206:19964 is 316 x 252 at (30.0002, 12); its four rows sit at y = 0 / 64 / 128 / 192 and each row lays five 60 x 60 tiles at x = 0 / 64 / 128 / 192 / 256, so the gutter is a flat 4 in BOTH axes and both axes close exactly (5x60 + 4x4 = 316, 4x60 + 3x4 = 252); each tile carries a 42.7564 `Heads` face at an 8.6473 inset; the stat footer 9206:19911 is 343 x 58 at (16, 277) with two 162.5 x 46 fields at x=6 and x=174.5 on a 6 pad and a 6 gutter (6 + 162.5 + 6 + 162.5 + 6 = 343). ITEM 1, THE GUTTER RATIO, CLOSED. One ratio served both boards and the boards do not agree on it: the desktop cuts draw 8 on a 112.63317 tile (0.07102) and these cuts draw 4 on a 60 (0.06667), so driving the phone off the desktop figure put the tile at 59.80 on a 4.25 gap. `TILE_GAP_RATIO` now carries the two figures and `useTileMetrics` derives a tile fraction from each; the phone rung lands 60.000000 on 4.000000 and the desktop rung 112.633 on 8.000, both asserted. The art ratio did NOT move (42.7564/60 = 0.71261 against 80.1948/112.63317 = 0.71195, six ten-thousandths) which is what says one component redrawn on a rounder gutter, so only the gap was keyed. A SECOND DEFECT WAS FOUND WHILE CLOSING IT and is not in any earlier row: the gutter was emitted as a PERCENTAGE, which is only well defined on the inline axis - on the block axis it resolves against a height an auto-height grid does not have - and this is the one cut of the three that draws FOUR ROWS, so its 4 down the page was the axis a percentage could not state. It is now a container unit, which is the same split Keno's board makes for the same reason (KenoGame.tsx:1344). That forced the `container-type` onto a WRAPPER: `cqw` resolves against the nearest ANCESTOR container, never the element declaring it, so the cap moved with it and the grid is `w-full` inside a 316 / lg 595.1658 box - otherwise every tile would scale off a container wider than the grid it sits in. ITEM 2, THE FLOOR, CLOSED. The board carried a flat `max-lg:min-h-[357px]`, the CLASSIC cut's height (9178:14615, 375 x 357, carried and not re-read), where this cut and its Auto twin both draw 347; one floor has to be the tallest of three or the tallest clips, so 357 was holding ten pixels of air under the two shorter cuts and `justify-between` was spending it on the gaps. It is keyed to `layout`, the same discriminator the board branches its content on. The 347 is the content's own height: 12 pad + 252 grid + 12 gap + 58 footer + 12 pad = 346 inside 347, one pixel of slack. WHAT KEEPS THE ROW PARTIAL IS NOT GEOMETRY AND IS NOT THIS LANE'S TO CLOSE: the footer draws Multiplier 1.9800 at Win Chance 50.0000 (text nodes 9206:19920 and 9206:19948, read this pass). The win chance agrees with the rail; the multiplier does not - 1.9800 is a 1% edge and the rail pays coinMultiplier(currency), 1.9500 on chain and 1.9000 on POINTS, at the same 50.0000. The build drives the rail's own figure and that is correct and stays: a board is a picture of a number, never the number. This is the SAME SHAPE as 9204-17308 and the wave direction predicted more of them. NO CODE CHANGE on that path - decision D1 puts coinflip's odds, multiplier, edge and EV out of this lane's bounds, and the standing rule forbids moving a payout to match a design. CASEY CALL, three ways: (a) accept the rail's 1.9500 under the board's label and count the frame done on layout, (b) have the board's 1.9800 corrected in Figma to the rail's figure, or (c) rule the footer a frame-defect on both phone cuts. Second witness modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/games/instant/coinflip/coinflipTileGridWidth.test.ts; floor oracle coinflipPhoneBoardFloor.test.ts, new this pass. 161 tests green across the 14 coinflip suites; scoped tsc exit 0, 0 errors, all four touched files proved in-program with --listFiles. Commit on skai-gaming main, not pushed - Ruling 16; partial here means landed, not live.

The stat footer 11082:13870 is 343 x 58 at (16, 277), byte-identical in shape to the Target cut's. BOTH OPEN ITEMS FROM WAVE 59 ARE CLOSED HERE, and the reasoning and the arithmetic are stated in full on 9206-19903 rather than restated: the gutter ratio is keyed per rung so this cut's tile lands its own 60 on 4 instead of 59.80 on 4.25, and the phone floor is keyed to `layout` so this cut carries the 347 it draws instead of the Classic cut's 357. The block-axis half of the gutter fix does not bear on THIS cut - it draws one row - but it is one component and the Target cut needs it. ONE ITEM THIS ROW ADDS STAYS RECORDED, NOT BUILT, and it is unchanged from wave 59: the row's VERTICAL placement. 123.5 is 15 below a centring of the space above the footer (108.5), and 2 x 123.5 + 60 = 307, so it is exact centring in a 307-tall region nothing on the board draws. That is the SAME SHAPE as the desktop Auto cuts, where the row sits 18.000 below its centring inside an implied 547 (9204-17690): the Auto row is drawn below centre on every cut, by 15 here and 18 there, and no board states either region. Corroborated across two widths and left as a measurement - a literal would break the moment the board's height moves. WHAT KEEPS THE ROW PARTIAL, as on its twin: the footer draws Multiplier 1.9800 at Win Chance 50.0000 (11082:13879, 11082:13894, read this pass) and the rail pays 1.9500 on chain / 1.9000 on POINTS at that same 50.0000. The code is right and the frame is wrong; D1 puts that path out of this lane's bounds and the standing rule forbids moving a payout to match a design. Same three-way Casey call as 9206-19903, and one ruling closes both rows. Inside it, and this is the part no earlier row carried: EVERY SEAM IS 24. `Frame 1000004222` 11894:18728 375x1553 at y=0 (the title row 9691:11946 343x32 at x=16 plus the bento 9691:11953 375x1505 at y=48); More games `Main container` 11894:18433 343x254 at (16, 1577), which is 1553 + 24; Bets `Main container` 11894:18541 343x204 at (16, 1855), which is 1831 + 24; the `line` vector 11894:18589 343x0 at y=2083, which is 2059 + 24; About/FAQ `Frame 642` 11894:18590 343x1097 at (16, 2107), which is 2083 + 24 and closes the column exactly (2107 + 1097 = 3204). THE SEAM ALREADY MATCHES AND NEEDED NO CHANGE: `PLAY_SECTION_GAP_CLASS.section` is `mt-6 md:mt-8 lg:mt-10` and `PLAY_SECTION_DIVIDER_CLASS` carries the same ramp, so the phone rung is already the 24 this board draws, in all four places including the rule. The three blocks decompose as handed over and each on an 8 seam under its heading: More games = heading `Frame 345` 11894:18434 343x36 + 8 + row 11894:18444 958x210; Bets = heading 11894:18542 343x24 + 8 + `Frame 279` 11894:18576 343x172; About/FAQ = content 11894:18591 343x653 + 24 + FAQ 11894:18651 343x420. The code already draws all three of those seams (`gap-2` on both section headings, `gap-6` on the About/FAQ row). ★★ WHAT THIS PASS OVERTURNS IS THE FRAMING, NOT THE ARITHMETIC. The hand-off read as three heights a later pass could check; they are not checkable as heights, because two of the three bodies are LIVE-DATA boxes and the board fixes each at one data state. The More-games row is 210 because its canonical tile `Frame 623` 11894:18455 is art 130x184 + an 8 seam + a meta row `Frame 607` 11894:18461 that is 18 tall around an 18x18 `images/circle`; the build draws that row as a 10px status dot on 12/14 Mulish (TILE_COUNT_RAMP, measured at 11100:70306) so its tile is 206, AND it renders the row only when `playing > 0` - a deliberate recorded divergence, since the frames' own count is a placeholder identical on all eight tiles. So the block is 254, 250 or 236 depending on who is playing, and no styling closes it. The Bets body's 172 is likewise the EMPTY state drawn out (11894:18580 `No bet history` over `You haven't placed any bets yet`, a 330x32 CTA row, and a 311x16 strip at y=144). ONE THING MEASURED AND DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT: `Main container` 11894:18433 closes at 254 = 36 + 8 + 210 with NOTHING below the row, while the shelf draws `pb-2` (PlayGameDetailSections.tsx:1056) under a `scrollbar-hide` scroller, so it reserves 8 for a scrollbar that is hidden and the board does not draw. That file is mine and the change is one token, but it is a SHARED surface every routed game page draws at every width, and I measured one board at one rung; the 768 and 1440 cuts have not been read against it. Recorded for a pass that reads them, rather than moving fifteen pages on one board. THE 44px FLOOR DOES NOT BITE HERE, checked rather than assumed: the board's two under-44 controls are the 36x36 shelf arrows (11894:18441, 11894:18442) and the 109x24 Bets pill (11894:18549); the arrows render as `aria-hidden` SPANS, which `src/index.css:775-777` does not select (it selects button, a and [role=button]), and the pill already carries `no-min-size` at :1216. Nothing to opt out on this frame. NO CODE CHANGE THIS PASS.
